mgmplus.us.title: The Ring
mgmplus.us.description: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2002

movies.us.description: Four survivors of the Ghostface murders leave Woodsboro behind for a fresh start in New York City. However, they soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when a new killer embarks on a bloody rampage. - 2023

movies.us.title: Rosemary's Baby
movies.us.description: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth. (Horror) - 1968

movies.us.title: Apartment 7A
movies.us.description: Terry Gionoffrio dreams of fame and fortune in New York City, but after suffering an injury, an older, wealthy couple welcomes her into their home in Bramford. When she receives an offer at another chance at fame, it seems that all her dreams are coming true. However, disturbing circumstances soon have her second-guessing the sacrifices she's willing to make for her career as she realizes that something evil is living in apartment 7A. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

screenpixaction.us.title: The Vampire
screenpixaction.us.description: A small-town doctor (John Beal) cannot stop taking the pills that turn him into a fanged killer. - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Planet of the Vampires
screenpixaction.us.description: An astronaut (Barry Sullivan) and his partner (Norma Bengell) flee from walking-dead astronauts on a volcanic planet. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpixaction.us.title: Blood Bath
screenpixaction.us.description: A reincarnated 15th-century vampire sets his sights on the women of modern-day California. Produced by Roger Corman. (Horror) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: No Such Thing
screenpix.us.description: In Iceland a New York journalist (Sarah Polley) meets a reptilian monster (Robert John Burke) which slaughtered her fiancé and a television crew. - 2001

screenpix.us.title: The Last Man on Earth
screenpix.us.description: The survivor (Vincent Price) of a global epidemic battles a race of zombie vampires in an adaptation of Richard Matheson's "I Am Legend." (Science fiction, Horror) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Ape
screenpix.us.description: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan. (Horror) - 1940

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sheba, Baby
screenpixvoices.us.description: A private investigator tries to rescue her father's financially imperiled loan business. - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Mama, White Mama
screenpixvoices.us.description: Lee Daniels (Pam Grier) is a black girl busted for prostitution. Karen Brent (Margaret Markov) is a white girl arrested for her involvement with a local revolutionary group. The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away. (Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (Crime drama) - 1975

mgmplushits.us.title: Sabrina
mgmplushits.us.description: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond). - 1995

mgmplushits.us.title: The Naked Gun
mgmplushits.us.description: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down. (Comedy, Action) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: Spaceballs
mgmplushits.us.description: In a distant galaxy, planet Spaceball has depleted its air supply, leaving its citizens reliant on a product called "Perri-Air." In desperation, Spaceball's leader President Skroob (Mel Brooks) orders the evil Dark Helmet (Rick Moranis) to kidnap Princess Vespa (Daphne Zuniga) of oxygen-rich Druidia and hold her hostage in exchange for air. But help arrives for the Princess in the form of renegade space pilot Lone Starr (Bill Pullman) and his half-man, half-dog partner, Barf (John Candy). (Comedy, Science fiction) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man. - 1997

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Lions for Lambs
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Inspired by their idealistic professor, Dr. Mallery (Robert Redford), to do something meaningful with their lives, Arian (Derek Luke) and Ernest (Michael Peña) join the military and ship out to Afghanistan. Their experiences tie together two separate but related stories. In California, Mallery tries to break through to a disaffected student, while in Washington, D.C., a presidential hopeful (Tom Cruise) prepares to give a journalist (Meryl Streep) the scoop of a lifetime. (Drama) - 2007

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return. (Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2004

moremax.us.title: The Player

moremax.us.title: Flashpoint
moremax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

moremax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
moremax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

movieplex.us.title: Lulu on the Bridge
movieplex.us.description: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino). - 1998

movieplex.us.title: Quartet
movieplex.us.description: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice. (Comedy drama) - 2012

movieplex.us.title: Iron Eagle on the Attack
movieplex.us.description: Retired from the Air Force, Chappy Sinclair (Lou Gossett Jr.) now runs a private flight school that happens to cater to misfits and juvenile offenders. Desperate to instill discipline, Chappy hires as an instructor his former protégé, Doug Masters (Jason Cadieux), who had previously been shot down by the Soviets. During training, Doug and the youths encounter drug dealers, toxic chemicals and an insidious conspiracy that threatens to ignite a global war. (Action) - 1995

skycinemafamily.uk.description: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Angry Birds Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Flightless birds lead a mostly happy existence, except for Red, who just can't get past the daily annoyances of life. His temperament leads him to anger management class, where he meets fellow misfits Chuck and Bomb. Red becomes even more agitated when his feathered brethren welcome green pigs to their island paradise. As the swine begin to get under his skin, Red joins forces with Chuck and Bomb to investigate the real reason behind their mysterious arrival.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends are surprised when a green pig suggests that they put aside their differences and unite to fight a common threat. Aggressive birds from an island covered in ice are planning to use an elaborate weapon to destroy the fowl and swine way of life. After picking their best and brightest, the birds and pigs come up with a scheme to infiltrate the island, deactivate the device and return to their respective paradises intact.

The Doc sets out on an adventure like none other to find these hardened criminals and ends up forging a friendship with Wyatt Earp that would carry into the events of Tombstone.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Immaculate
bbctwoengland.uk.description: Horror starring Sydney Sweeney and Alvaro Morte. Young novice nun Sister Cecilia comes from the suburbs of Detroit and is invited by Father Tedeschi to join a renowned convent in Italy, where she is asked to provide care to the ageing nuns who reside there. Cecilia settles in to her new life and takes her vows of chastity. Yet, despite being a virgin, she becomes pregnant and a miracle is declared.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: His House
bbctwoengland.uk.description: Horror starring Wunmi Mosaku and Sope Dìrísù. A married couple flee South Sudan and are granted probational asylum in the UK. They tackle racism, bureaucracy and survivors' guilt as they try to adapt to their new life, but the biggest challenge of all is their dilapidated council house - which is home to a malevolent spirit that won't leave them alone.

bbctwoengland.uk.title: Saving Lives at Sea
bbctwoengland.uk.description: S11 E6 Lifeguard Emergency In Watergate Bay, one of Cornwall's surfing hotspots, two teenage boys are caught in one of the beach's notorious rip currents. When three distress signals are activated off the Pembrokeshire coast, the Fishguard crew race out to their location, discovering seven kayakers in need of rescue. On one of the hottest days of the year, the Lyme Regis crew receive reports of a man suffering from heat stroke.

skydrama.uk.description: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend. (Drama / Children) - 1991

skydrama.uk.title: True Grit (2010)
skydrama.uk.description: When her father is murdered, young 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel. (Adventure / Drama / Western) - 2010

skydrama.uk.title: The Cut (2024)
skydrama.uk.description: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul. (Drama / Thriller) - 2024

skygreats.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982)
skygreats.uk.description: Heartwarming tale in which a ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects. (Adventure / Science fiction / Children) - 1982

skygreats.uk.title: Matilda (1996)
skygreats.uk.description: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress. (Comedy / Children) - 1996

skygreats.uk.title: Paulie (1998)
skygreats.uk.description: A wisecracking parrot caged in a research lab tells his life story to a lonely janitor. Before coming to the science lab, he has passed through the hands of a succession of owners, from a petty criminal to a man who runs a parrot-dancing act. Touched by his colourful story, the janitor conspires to liberate the talking bird. (Adventure / Comedy / Drama / Children) - 1998

skythriller.uk.title: Mr & Mrs Smith (2005)
skythriller.uk.description: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other. - 2005

skythriller.uk.title: GoodFellas (1990)
skythriller.uk.description: Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive. (Crime drama) - 1990

skythriller.uk.title: Lurker (2025)
skythriller.uk.description: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death. (Drama / Thriller) - 2025

M6.fr.title: Arnaques !
M6.fr.description: E22Près de l'aéroport d'Orly, une société malveillante proposait à ses clients de garder leurs voitures. En réalité, ces escrocs encaissaient l'argent et utilisaient les véhicules des particuliers dans des conditions douteuses voire pire. "Arnaques !" fait le point de ce dossier complexe et sinueux.

M6.fr.title: Arnaques !
M6.fr.description: E12 — Foires : arnaques ou bonnes affaires ?Chaque année, 1200 foires et salons sont organisés en France. Et c'est un succès à chaque fois : 230 000 exposants et près de 23 millions de visiteurs y sont recensés en moyenne. L'objectif des clients est de payer moins cher. Mais les prix sont-ils vraiment intéressants par rapport aux autres points de vente ?

M6.fr.title: Arnaques !
M6.fr.description: E12 — Foires : arnaques ou bonnes affaires ?Les clients des foires en passent souvent par la case camelots. Ces vendeurs extravertis savent vendre avec un talent certain et un bagout de bon aloi. Mais les produits mis en avant sont-ils tous de bonne qualité ? Le magazine a mené l'enquête pour en savoir plus sur ce phénomène.

CANAL+.Sport.4.HD.pl.title: Piłka nożna: PKO BP Ekstraklasa - mecz: Wisła Kraków - Śląsk Wrocław
